interventions.detail: Installed Node.js v22.21.1 (tarball) and yarn 1.22.22 to build the frontend; not in image and not mentioned in README
Node 20 (as in Dockerfile) / 22.12 too old: vite 7 and eslint-visitor-keys need node >=20.19 / >=22.13
Built frontend from source (yarn install && yarn build) and pip install -e . since README's pip install gives PyPI 0.7.0, not the repo code
workspace_factory.get_active_workspace_id falls back to DF_DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ID env when X-Workspace-Id header is absent, so plain API clients work
Set DATA_FORMULATOR_HOME and BROWSER=true for headless background run
